title: Platform checks (contract v2)
description: Written by the runner to /trial/out/checks.json after every trial (evals_adapter.checks), never by the adapter. Number provenance: every money amount the agent wrote, and whether a tool result, the task's client file or a user message holds it at the precision shown. Required tool calls: which of the task's required_tools the agent called. Heuristics for a reader and a grader primitive, not a grade. See docs/adapter-contract.md section 12.

amounts.description: Every money amount in the agent's replies, in order: ₹, Rs, INR or 'rupees' amounts, lakh and crore forms, and Indian digit grouping from one lakh up.

turn.description: The agent turn the reply belongs to, from 0.

text.description: The amount as written, such as '₹4.41 lakh'.

supported_by.description: Where a matching number was: a tool result (tool), the task's client file (client), or a user or simulated-client message (user); null when nothing matched, a calculation with no tool behind it.

where.description: tool:<tool name>, client:<file name>, or <source>:<transcript index> for a message (task:0, client_sim:2).

how.description: exact; rounded half-up to the precision shown (or at trailing zeros, within 1%); truncated to the precision shown.

precision.description: The step the amount was compared at, in rupees: 0.01 for '₹8,997.26', 1000 for '₹4.41 lakh'.

unsupported.description: How many amounts have supported_by null.

tools_called.description: Every tool the agent called, once each, in first-call order, with harness prefixes removed (Hermes's mcp__finance__).

required_tools.description: Null when the task lists no required_tools.

called.description: Required tools with at least one execute_tool span.

only_errors.description: Called required tools whose every call returned an error.
